description: Reports a Vercel site's errors, traffic and speed: runtime error logs, failing requests, page views, visitors, top pages, referrers, and Core Web Vitals. Trigger on requests like "what errors did my site have in the last 30 minutes", "why am I getting 500s", "show me the logs", "how is my traffic this week", or "which pages are slowest". Read only.
